Name: All-Mach Orb
Description: Raises Speed modifier by 2, range: all team members

Name: Blowback Orb
Description: Pushes a target back 6 tiles. If they collide with a wall or Pokémon, they take 1d6 damage, range: foe in front

Name: Cleanse Orb
Description: Cleans sticky and gummed up items, range: all team members

Name: Decoy Orb
Description: Gives foe Taunted, range: foe in front

Name: Drought Orb
Description: Dries up all water and magma on floor.

Name: Escape Orb
Description: Allows escape from dungeon, range: all team members

Name: Foe-Seal Orb
Description: Gives foes into Restrained status, range: foes in front

Name: Foe-Fear Orb
Description: Gives foes into Frightened status, range: foes in front

Name: Snowy Orb
Description: Starts Snowstorm weather

Name: Identify Orb
Description: Reveals all held items of Pokémon, range: whole floor

Name: Invisify Orb
Description: Gives Invisible status, range: user

Name: Lasso Orb
Description: Pulls the target 1 tile towards you, range: 2 tiles away

Name: Luminous Orb
Description: Reveals entire floor

Name: Mobile Orb
Description: Raises Speed Modifier by 2, range: user

Name: Nullify Orb
Description: Nullifies all Abilities on the current floor

Name: One-Room Orb
Description: Breaks down all walls in the current floor

Name: One-Shot Orb
Description: Roll a d6 for each foe in the Room. On a 3-6, the Foe is knocked in one hit, range: Room

Name: Pierce Orb
Description: Items thrown in a straight line by the Pokémon will pass through obstacles, range: user

Name: Radar Orb
Description: Reveals the number of foes on the current floor

Name: Rainy Orb
Description: Starts Rain weather on the current floor

Name: Rebound Orb
Description: Gives Counter and Mirror Coat status, which ends when reflecting damage for the first time, range: user

Name: Rollcall Orb
Description: Draws all team members next to user, range: floor

Name: Sandy Orb
Description: Starts Sandstorm weather on the current floor

Name: Scanner Orb
Description: Reveals the number of unclaimed items on floor

Name: See-Trap Orb
Description: Reveals all traps on floor

Name: Silence Orb
Description: Gives Silenced status, range: foes in a 2-tile radius

Name: Slow Orb
Description: Lowers foes' Speed Modifier by 2, range: foes in room

Name: Slumber Orb
Description: Gives Asleep status, range: foe in front

Name: Snatch Orb
Description: Physical moves steal the Pokémon’s held item, range: user

Name: Storage Orb
Description: Allows you to access your Storage

Name: Sunny Orb
Description: Starts Sunny weather on the current floor

Name: Switcher Orb
Description: Switches position with another Pokémon you can see, range: user

Name: Totter Orb
Description: Gives Confused status, range: foe in front

Name: Trapbust Orb
Description: Destroys all Traps on the current floor

Name: Trawl Orb
Description: Draws all items to user, range: current floor

Name: Weather Lock Orb
Description: Ends any Weather conditions on the current floor, and it cannot be changed.

Name: Warp Orb
Description: Warps foe to elsewhere on the same floor, range: foe in front
